mentions.name: Ternary Search
mentions.description: A competitive programming practice site that lets users compete against friends solving ICPC-style questions, recreating the mechanics of the former binarysearch.com, with the goal of building a community around open sourcing an online judge.
mentions.problem: The site binarysearch.com, which let people compete against friends on leetcode-style questions, was taken down by its developers, leaving that style of competitive practice site unavailable.
mentions.audience: Hoping the competitive programming scene will take a liking to it.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on (https://ternarysearch.com), a site with the same mechanics, but a focus on ICPC-style questions. Hoping the competitive programming scene will take a liking to it, I'd love to build a community around open sourcing an online judge.
